newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banco Garantia buys Brazil supermarket chain-paper.
newsitem.headline: Banco Garantia buys Brazil supermarket chain-paper.

text.p: GP Investimentos, a unit of Brazilian investment bank Garantia, has acquired Sao Paulo-based supermarket chain Se for an undisclosed amount, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper reported.
Garantia officials were not immediately available to confirm the report.
According to the paper, the acquisition of Supermercados Se adds to Garantia's holdings in the country's retail sector.
The bank controls local retailer Lojas Americanas and, last month, sold its stake in troubled supermarket chain Supermar to local supermarket group Bompreco, it said.
Supermercados Se has 18 branches and revenues totalled 513 million reais in 1996, Gazeta said.
